revisionDesc.change: General - I have checked the image from https://berlpap.smb.museum/02359/. There is a small horizontal stroke in front the the my of Μαρκιανός. I cannot really see much more but think that there is space for the traces of 3-4 letters. I have subtracted that from the 12 that had previously been estimated.

Vote - AcceptText - I agree with Nick and would leave lin1 unrestored. There are certainly traces before Μαρκιανὸς, which should be tagged. Furthermore, these traces and the preserved part of the papyrus surface leave some doubts if the restoration is actually correct. One would expect visible traces at least of the rho of Ἀλεξάνδρου.

Vote - AcceptText - The reading of the address on the back is good, but I'd leave lin1 unrestored, since there doesn't seem to be room for all of [κυρίῳ μου ἀδελφῷ Ἀλεξάνδρῳ] in this line (NB trace before Μαρκιανὸς).

Submit - Added corrections from BL 11 and 13 and a reading of the address on the back (from which l. 1 restored). NB: not sure of best way to represent BL 11 correction, which restores reading of ed. pr.
